items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: even on the West Bank of the River where my cousin Lloyd Spencer had Lloyd's Esquire line

ctx.x: So you must have been out all night.

No, I had traveled quite a bit. See, at that time, I was working for a brown, brown, see, that was a liquor company. You know, this old, old Forrester, and early times, and King Liquor at that time. And I used to travel all through Louisiana and part of Texas. If you notice, I have a lot, a lot about Texas in here, about, well, Forrestal, what is the name, Rosenthal out of Orange, Texas, who was a big time promoter. He and Frank Pannier, they were co-promoters on shows from New Orleans all the way over to Orange,…
I'm just curious stuff about Butch Curran, about the traveling, about writing the column and so forth. Go and put your date on it again and put your billboard on it.

items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: my cousin Lloyd Spencer, who at one time had Lloyd's Esquire Lounge, who used to promote Dave Bartholomew and all those guys over there.

ctx.x: For William Taff, when you came to the president. President William Howard Taff. You said your grandfather was involved. Yeah, my grandfather was involved with that. What was his name? His name was Taylor, Lewis Taylor. He's not in here. I was looking for him, but this came out of his files. I got a hold of this some kind of way before he died, but he was a good friend with quite a few of these people who served on the executive committee, and they got him involved. That's, you know, because I talked with him,…

They died and the building was sold. Now, my cousin Lloyd Spencer, who at one time had Lloyd's Esquire Lounge, who used to promote Dave Bartholomew and all those guys over there. And incidentally, Lloyd is still alive today. I guess he could fill you in on a lot of people. He had Lloyd's Esquire Lounge over there in Gretna. And then another good friend, I guess I can say he's into my family because Merlin Dennis, who had the Peppermot Lounge in Gretna, he's married to my cousin. He's still alive, but he's kind of…
You seem to know just, yeah, that's what I was going to get back to. They marched on certain holidays.
